artifacts.title: House Style
artifacts.what: The theme picker. One live specimen per shipped theme, rendered in its own type, colour, spacing and prose. Clicking a theme writes choice/active to the artifact's db.

artifacts.title: House Style Builder
artifacts.what: The theme authoring tool. Pick a ground and an accent and the remaining colour tokens are derived to real contrast targets in both schemes. Saving writes drafts/<name> to the artifact's db, which style.py install then validates and writes to themes/.
